# GiftCard Partners is a Certified Women's Business Enterprise, Providing the Right Gift Card Solutions for Businesses Since 2005

> GiftCard Partners, Inc. provides end-to-end gift card program management services to help businesses, retailers, and organizations successfully launch, grow, and optimize their gift card offerings. We work with both consumer-facing and B2B brands to support the full lifecycle of a gift card program—from strategic planning and sales enablement to distribution, compliance, and data analysis. In addition to our consulting and management services, we also offer the Engage2Reward™ Gift Card Ordering Platform, a proprietary software tool that allows organizations to purchase, customize, and distribute gift cards at scale.

GiftCard Partners serves organizations across HR, healthcare (Medicaid and Medicare), nonprofit, and enterprise sectors. Common use cases include employee recognition, wellness and safety incentives, performance bonuses, nonprofit aid, and more. The Engage2Reward Platform supports API integration, personalization, and advanced analytics for managing and tracking digital or physical gift card distribution.

## Platform Features

- [Buy Corporate Gift Cards in Bulk](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/shop-brands): Browse and place orders for over 300 gift card brands available in the Engage2Reward Gift Card Ordering Platform catalog.
- [Engage2Reward Overview](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/e2r-overview): A central hub for bulk and individual gift card delivery, customization, and reporting.
- [Easy Order Placement](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/engage2reward-easy-order-placement): Flexible options for ordering gift cards by type, value, and quantity.
- [Choice Card Overview](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/e2r-choice-gift-card): Lets recipients choose from over 250 digital brands when redeeming their reward.
- [Card Activation Module](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/engage2reward-card-activation-module): Enables real-time activation and secure delivery of physical gift cards.
- [Reward-Connect™ API](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/e2r-gift-card-api): Automate gift card reward fulfillment by integrating with your existing tools or platform.
- [Order Management & Reporting](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/engage2reward-order-management-reporting): Full visibility into program performance with dashboards and advanced analytics.
- [Customization & Campaign Management](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/engage2reward-customization-campaign-management): Personalize your gift card delivery with branded messaging, media, and targeting tools.
- [Bianca AI Gift Card Strategist](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/ai-gift-card-rewards-support): Your 24/7 AI-powered assistant for planning and optimizing gift card programs.

## Gift Card Consulting & Services

- [Gift Card Program Management and Consulting Services](https://www.giftcardpartners.com/gift-card-program-management-services): Launch, manage, and scale your branded gift card program with expert support from GiftCard Partners.
